text.autoconfig.smartautoreconnect.title: Smart Auto Reconnect
text.autoconfig.smartautoreconnect.optio: On (default): an involuntary disconnect (kick, timeout, connection loss) retries up to 5 times, 30-110s backoff. Direct-connect/server-list only, not Realms/LAN.
TOAST_ONLY: toasts only. TOAST_AND_BUTTON (default): also a Cancel button on the disconnect screen.
On (default): give up entirely after 4+ disconnects within 5 minutes (reconnect-then-instant-kick usually means a client-side problem, not the server).
